Engineering

Built from the Ground Up

{/* Card 1 — Chassis */}

Mechanical Design

Custom Mechanical Chassis

Our drive base is fully custom-designed and machined in-house — optimized for rapid direction changes, low center of gravity, and sub-50ms encoder feedback loops. Every bracket and gusset was iterated through at least three design reviews.

  • ≥ 4-wheel differential swerve configuration
  • Custom CNC-machined aluminum plates
  • Modular subsystem mounting rails
  • Optimized gear ratios per competition task

    while (opModeIsActive()) {

      double strafe =  gamepad1.left_stick_x;
      double turn   =  gamepad1.right_stick_x;
      // Field-centric mecanum logic...
    }
  }
}`}

Software Architecture

Java / NextFTC Architecture

Our software stack is built on Java with the NextFTC framework — giving us clean command-based control flow, a fully state-machine-driven autonomous, and a dead-reckoning odometry system accurate to ±2cm per field traversal.

  • NextFTC command-based architecture
  • Three-wheel odometry localization
  • PID tuned via telemetry dashboard
  • Automated multi-cycle autonomous routines
